invariants.rule: Species builder, reference and GM inspector surfaces project governed owner state; UI labels, layout, controls and display state are never canonical rules authority.
MVPS-14 may compose authorized species authoring intent and validation previews, but canonical persistence, promotion and publication occur only through owning workflows.
Visibility filtering occurs before search, autocomplete, count, preview, dependency/cross-link derivation, export, diagnostics or AI context; hidden cardinality/topology is not leaked.
Authorized inspection exposes exact identity/version plus available source/provenance, validation and migration evidence; missing/conflicted evidence remains explicit rather than fabricated.
Presentation assets, names, labels, layout and visualization cannot create, replace or remove species mechanics; executable meaning remains in canonical owner records and receipts.
Builder and GM surfaces may consume MVPS-13 runtime contributions and grant receipts but cannot mutate, reorder or reinterpret them as source truth.
Hidden, forbidden or unknown species facts are not inferred from search gaps, counts, cross-links, assets, runtime behavior or GM-only evidence.
Species cross-links preserve stable identity and exact-version semantics where required; display-name changes and presentation aliases never retarget canonical references.

enforcement.ci_step: Run MVPS-14 authoring search inspection presentation regressions
